content.rendered:
Timeline for Upcoming Events

  • April 1st – April 9th: SCS At Home optional supplemental learning available 
  • April 3rd: Distance Learning for All Parent Survey emailed to families
  • April 6th: Distance Learning for All Parent Survey due by noon! 
  • April 9th: Save the date! Designated item pick up day (details to be announced soon)
  • April 13th: Required Distance Learning For All Begins

Worried you might have missed a previous SCS announcement? 

You can view all previous announcements regarding the school closure, SCS At Home Supplemental Learning, and Distance Learning for All on the school website here. This page will continue to be updated.

How do I contact the school or my student’s teacher? 

Please keep in mind that SCS teachers and staff are working at home with limited resources. The office is monitoring emails and phone messages, however due to the high volume of questions and the extensive planning required to establish Distance Learning for All, please expect some delay in response time. 

SCS Office Email: office@sherwoodcharterschool.org

SCS Phone: 503-925-8007 (leave a message and office will follow up by email)

As we launch Distance Learning for All, teachers are working to establish individual “office hours” where they can be available to families for assistance. Please be respectful and use those designated times to contact your student’s teachers and assist your students to do the same. To help keep everyone organized, we are hoping to publish some kind of schedule in the coming weeks.  

Emotional Support Services-School Counselor Kaylie Buchanan

If you are in need of emotional support, our school counselor Kaylie Buchanan is available. Please email or call to set up an appointment.

Kaylie Buchanan Email: kbuchanan@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Google voice phone number: (503) 610-8890

Additionally, the Oregon Department of Education has also compiled a list of mental health service resources here. 

Food Assistance and Childcare

If you’re needing supplemental services of food assistance and/or child care, the Sherwood School District has resources that can be found here. 

Guidance for At Home Learning-ODE Resource

The Oregon Department of Education has provided guidance for families with key points to remember and recommendations to help with the transition to at home learning which can be found here.  

School Board Announcement

The Sherwood Board of Directors have suspended all board meetings in light of the public gathering restrictions in place during the COVID-19 pandemic and mandated school closures. We will return to meetings as scheduled when restrictions are lifted and school operations resume.

Have a great weekend!
